html:
Charlotte, NC, September 19, 2017 — Meridian Local of Charlotte, NC, has joined the National Pest Management Association (NPMA) as an Allied Member. NPMA is a national association that is made up of 7,000 members and over 5,500 pest management companies nationwide.

The NPMA focuses on the education, growth and profitability of pest control and management specialists to ensure the success of the industry. Continued education of NPMA members means more knowledgeable pest control specialists for home and business owners alike. Meridian Local’s goal is to educate and assist NPMA members with online marketing solutions fit for their business and industry. With online marketing solutions available to them, NPMA members will be able to reach more customers in their local area.

About Meridian Local

Meridian Local is a division of Meridian Media Group, Inc., one of the nation’s largest media companies. Meridian Local is a digital marketing and solutions organization that specializes in creating the total web presence small businesses need to make sure they reach their online audience.

When clients partner with Meridian Local, they choose a team of industry-leading experts. Currently, Meridian Local serves 12,000+ live clients on a month-to-month basis. Visit meridianlocal.com for more information.

About NPMA

The National Pest Management Association (NPMA), a non-profit organization with more than 7,000 members from around the world, was established in 1933 to support the pest management industry’s commitment to the protection of public health, food and property. This commitment is reflected both in the continuing education of pest management professionals and the dissemination of timely information to homeowners and businesses. Visit npmapestworld.org for more information.
